comment: A DefinedTerm naming the service (OGC Web Map Service, OGC Web Feature Service) with its termCode (OGC:WMS, OGC:WFS) and the version. @type is schema:Dataset and schema:WebAPI, as the ISO converter writes a service record. The @id is the GetCapabilities URL: the caller's --capabilities-url, else the GetCapabilities operation's address.
With none, the description is the name.
A DefinedTerm in the keyword's vocabulary (WMS vocabulary attribute, OWS Type codeSpace) when it names one, else a string.
The service's web page (WMS Service OnlineResource, OWS ProviderSite). Else the service endpoint.
An Organization: ContactOrganization (WMS) or ProviderName (OWS), with the contact's email and telephone.
A schema:Role pointOfContact whose contributor is the named person (ContactPerson, IndividualName) with their position, email and telephone, affiliated to the provider.
Fees and access constraints, labelled and joined: the webAPI block's terms of service. With neither, 'not specified', the block's own default.
Also the dataset's conditions of access ('none' is kept: it says there are none). With no constraints and no licence, schema:license is the OGC nil URI.
A Creative Commons, Open Data Commons or SPDX URL, or an etalab / data.gov licence URL, written in the fees or constraints, as a CreativeWork.

Each operation (GetCapabilities, GetMap, GetFeatureInfo, DescribeFeatureType, GetFeature, ...) a schema:Action named by the operation, whose target is an EntryPoint at its HTTP Get (else Post) address with httpMethod and the formats it returns as contentType.

Each named WMS layer or WFS feature type, as a schema:CreativeWork whose additionalType is 'WMS layer' or 'WFS feature type' (as a schema:Dataset CDIF would require each to carry a full record of its own): Title its name, Name its identifier, Abstract its description, keywords, and its WGS 84 box (a WMS layer inherits its nearest ancestor's) as spatialCoverage. MetadataURL becomes a LinkRole (describedby).
The union of the WMS layers' boxes (the root layer's, when it has one, contains the rest) or of the feature types' WGS 84 boxes, as one Place with a GeoShape box (S W N E).
INSPIRE extended capabilities: the service's metadata record, as a LinkRole (describedby).
The language the service answers in (ISO 639-2).
When the updateSequence is a date. Capabilities documents otherwise carry no date: dateModified is the sentinel 1900-01-01.
Time and elevation dimensions, styles and legend URLs are not converted.
Query and filter conformance is not converted.
